shortDescription: Enables/disables a module of the Apache2 webserver

options.name: force
options.description: Force disabling of default modules and override Debian warnings.

options.name: identifier
options.description: Identifier of the module as listed by C(apache2ctl -M). This is optional and usually determined automatically by the common convention of appending V(_module) to O(name) as well as custom exception for popular modules.

options.name: ignore_configcheck
options.description: Ignore configuration checks about inconsistent module configuration. Especially for mpm_* modules.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the module to enable/disable as given to C(a2enmod)/C(a2dismod).

options.name: warn_mpm_absent
options.description: Control the behavior of the warning process for MPM modules.
